protocol.title: Droplet On Tape: Protocol

associated_publication.title: Drop-on-demand sample delivery for studying biocatalysts in action at X-ray free-electron lasers

protocol.platform: Acoustic Droplet Ejection (ADE) onto Kapton conveyor belt for XFEL sample delivery
applications: X-ray diffraction (XRD) from protein microcrystal slurry
X-ray emission spectroscopy (XES) from protein solution
Time-resolved reaction initiation (laser flash photolysis, gas activation)
Simultaneous XRD/XES with ancillary signals (transmission, fluorescence)

1_ADE_injector.description: Acoustic Droplet Ejection; focuses ultrasonic energy on liquid-air interface to eject nano-liter droplets
1_ADE_injector.transducer: Olympus V319-SU, 1 inch spherical focus, 15 MHz resonance

echo_probe.coupling: bi-directional coupler, 30 dB; samples forward and reverse signal

2_control_systems.tape_drive_interface: built-in serial terminal; connect via telnet from Linux or Mac
2_control_systems.motor_controller: Newport XPS-Q8 with EPICS interface (provided by SLAC)

3a_belt_material.supplier: BPB Inc., Bay Area, CA (custom request)
3a_belt_material.why_seamless: ultrasonically welded belts skip at weld over rollers, disrupting XFEL synchronisation
3a_belt_material.alternative_tested: Mylar film (inferior x-ray scattering properties vs Kapton)
3a_belt_material.lifespan: several shifts if XFEL beam does not directly hit belt

protocol.action: dry in vacuum oven (Precision vacuum oven, model 19)
dry in vacuum oven to remove residual FAS

3c_tensioner.mechanism: hanging weight torquing belt over two crowned rollers on rotating arm
3c_tensioner.adjustment: add or subtract weights hung from turntable
3c_tensioner.over_tension_indicator: belt starts to curl when tension is released
3c_tensioner.notes: system must allow repeatable and consistent tension; too much tension irreversibly damages belt; too little causes tracking failure

3d_crowned_rollers.crown_method: press-fitting bearing into CNC machined cap
3d_crowned_rollers.purpose: keeps belt centred on rollers during operation

3e_electrostatic_control.passive: steel anti-static brushes near belt drive mechanism
3e_electrostatic_control.active: Transforming Technologies IN3425 static gun spraying ionised air
3e_electrostatic_control.gun_position: near ADE deposition point to minimise electrostatic effects on ejection

3f_mounting.structure: modified Thorlabs aluminium breadboards and mounting brackets

3g_drive_mechanism.motor: Lexium M-Drive LMDCE423 micro-stepping stepper motor
3g_drive_mechanism.coupling: direct drive (geared mechanism abandoned due to velocity error)

4_sample_environment.door: large inflatable door with wide aperture near X-ray interaction region
4_sample_environment.joints: solvent welded where possible; rubber foam gaskets elsewhere
4_sample_environment.feed_through_panel: 0.125 inch aluminium, water-jet cut; accommodates electronic, gas, water, and fibre feed-throughs
4_sample_environment.helium_path_extension: thin inflatable polyethylene bags extend helium environment to detector to minimise scatter from heavier atoms in air
4_sample_environment.purpose: reduce scatter from air between sample and detector during XRD/XES

laser_excitation.ir_detection: bare ended fibres emit IR light; scatter collected onto photodiode
laser_excitation.excitation_monitoring: photodiodes on remote-accessible oscilloscopes collect excitation light passing through belt and sample

free_space_timing.description: single laser excitation using movable laser spot near XFEL interaction region
free_space_timing.lens: motorised 1 m focal length lens upstream of laser interaction region
free_space_timing.fine_timing: nanosecond precision via relative photodiode measurements

fiber_excitation_timing.principle: droplet spacing must be integer multiple or divisor of both 30 mm and 60 mm (IR gate spacings)
fiber_excitation_timing.ir_gate_coincidence: time coincidence of IR gate signals confirms droplets simultaneously present on all excitation points
fiber_excitation_timing.notes: deposition delay and belt speed are coupled; adjust incrementally

gas_activation.principle: conveyor belt passes through limited-extent reactive gas region (oxygen) via differential pumping
gas_activation.gas_confinement: series of small orifices separating helium partial pressure from reactive gas partial pressure
gas_activation.exposure_time: L / v_tape (L = reactive gas extent, v_tape = belt velocity)
gas_activation.dead_time: L_xfel / v_tape (L_xfel = distance from gas exit to XFEL interaction)
gas_activation.sealing: vacuum grease on all openings except belt entry and exit holes

environment.gas: Helium (enclosure fill, belt cleaning blow-off, differential pumping)

equipment.item: Polymicro tubing, 360 um O.D., 180-250 um I.D.
100 MHz or greater digital oscilloscope with remote access capability
KNF Neuberger N145.1.2AN.18 diaphragm pumps (x3, for belt blow-off)
Olympus V319-SU ultrasonic transducer (1 inch spherical focus, 15 MHz)
Custom machined components (see supplemental technical drawings)

belt_cleaning_procedure.method: four high-pressure water jets (200+ psi, 500 um I.D.)
belt_cleaning_procedure.drying: two compressed Helium blow-off nozzles (top and bottom)
belt_cleaning_procedure.blow_off_gas_source: three KNF Neuberger N145.1.2AN.18 gas-tight diaphragm pumps recirculating Helium from chamber
belt_cleaning_procedure.residue_detection: run belt dry with no sample; probe XES signal for background above baseline; performed periodically during beamtimes

steps.name: Kapton belt cleaning
steps.notes: Sonicate in Milli-Q water 10 min then isopropanol 10 min

steps.name: Belt vacuum drying before FAS treatment
Belt vacuum drying after FAS treatment
ADE injector setup and sample loading
steps.notes: Coupling water column isolates sample from transducer; syringe pump (Legato 130) controls sample influx rate

steps.name: Acoustic echo probe for fluid level QC
Laser excitation zone droplet transport
steps.operation: mix (belt transport through Helium enclosure to laser zone abstracted)

steps.name: Droplet-hit and timing confirmation
confirmation_methods: stroboscopic side-view camera synchronised to XFEL arrival
droplet explosion visible at zero camera delay

pass.action: dispose; proceed to XFEL data collection

fail.action: drain; re-adjust deposition delay or belt speed

steps.name: Simultaneous XES data collection
steps.spectrometer_environment: second Helium bag between XES crystal spectrometer and main Helium chamber

pass.action: dispose; proceed to belt residue check

steps.name: Belt residue QC check (XES background)
steps.method: run belt dry (no sample injected); probe XES signal for background above baseline

fail.action: dispose; belt clean for next shift
